Prove a recode with a before/after cross-tabulation

Source: R/catg.R
vrfrcd.Rd

Cross-tabulates the original and the recoded column and checks that the recode is a function of the original label (no category was split between two new ones), that it follows the declared mapping (a value the mapping does not name must be unchanged), that no row was lost or added and that missingness did not change. This is how swapped groups are caught before any model runs.

Usage

vrfrcd(orig, recd, decl)

Arguments

orig, recd

The column before and after the recode.

decl

The declared mapping, a named vector old = new.

Value

The cross-tabulation as a data frame (original, recoded, Freq), invisibly; an error at the first failed check.

See also

grdrcd(), vrfmrg().

Examples

o <- c("M", "F", "F", NA)
m <- c(M = "Male", F = "Female")
vrfrcd(o, grdrcd(o, m), m)
try(vrfrcd(o, c("Female", "Male", "Male", NA), m))
#> Error : vrfrcd: 'F' was mapped to 'Male' but the declared mapping says 'Female'. THIS is how groups get swapped; fix the recode before any model runs.
